text:
maria: kicking off FP8 kernel canary for atlas-13b on H100 and L40S. starting at 3% traffic on dedicated pools. run quick smoke and evals and drop notes here.

jin: copying. launching smoke using this command:
```
./canary --model atlas-13b --device=h100 --quant=fp8 --canary=0.03 --trace=kv,tiling
```

jin: first pass looks promising on H100: ~2.1x throughput, p50 latency down ~40%. no hard crashes so far. noticed some token timeouts at >6k context.

eva: ran eval set (redwood-evals + qnli slices). quick deltas vs fp16 baseline:
- ppl: +1.2% (worse)
- acc (qnli sample): -0.7% relative
- p50 latency: -38%
Quality regression is visible on reasoning prompts.

arjun: likely kv-tiling/granularity mismatch between fp16 path and new fp8 kernels. earlier we saw stray timeouts when tile boundaries shift. check runtime `KV_TILE_SIZE` and `tiling_policy` in logs.

jin: runtime trace snippet shows high act_scale in some MLP layers:
```
[2026-03-19T09:12:10Z] layer.22 act_scale=140 overflow_cnt=5 clip_mode=auto
[2026-03-19T09:12:10Z] layer.23 act_scale=72 overflow_cnt=0
```

arjun: clip_mode=auto is our mixed-precision safety. it clips activations when values overflow FP8 range which can alter downstream token probabilities.

eva: re-ran with `act_clip=96` and `precision_lock=true` (ensures per-request precision). results on L40S:
- ppl: +0.35%
- acc: -0.22%
- tail latency: +6% when fallback triggers
So lower clip threshold reduces drift but doesn't remove it.

jin: observed 3 sequences where the runtime toggled layer precision mid-request (fp8->fp16) and produced a short hallucination token before recovering.

maria: unacceptable for production. we need handshake semantics: either whole request in fp8 or fallback entire request to fp16 variant. partial-layer toggles cause distribution shifts.

arjun: I can add a `precision_lock=true` enforcement in the router/runtime that flips to model-variant-level fallback instead of per-layer. will add unit test for the atomic switch.

eva: I'll produce a CSV of prompt diffs classified into categories: token flip, repetition, reasoning-entropy. will attach examples.

ops-bot: canary update: scaled to 6% on h100-pool2 at 2026-03-19T09:25:03Z. logs and perf dashboards: https://internal.redwood/canaries/1739998888

jin: next technical steps I'm taking:
1) run per-layer activation histograms across 10k prompts to find hotspot layers
2) test `act_clip=dynamic` per-layer kernel option
3) run alternate quant backends (AWQ/GPTQ) on L40S where FP8 kernel isn't mature

arjun: also will harden the rollout atomicity. saw a race where two config pushes left half workers with handshake=false.

canary-bot: alert: 4 requests (out of ~18k) triggered per-request fallback at 2026-03-19T09:33:12Z. details logged.

maria: plan summary: jin owns histograms and AWQ fallback tests; arjun owns precision-lock patch and tests; eva assembles prompt-level diffs and impact matrix. goal: bring ppl delta <0.25% and eliminate mid-request precision toggles before increasing to 25% canary.

jin: starting histogram job now, ETA ~90m.

arjun: opening PR for handshake enforcement and will add atomic config apply. ping me here when CI passes.

maria: thanks. escalate immediately if you hit NaNs or generation corruption. otherwise update in this thread when histograms and diffs are in. :eyes:
